title: RunStage Gate config
description: Schema for .runstage/gate.yml. Mirrors the zod parser in packages/core/src/config.ts. Duplicate check names and ai_detection.policy.require_checks that do not match a defined check are rejected by the parser, not by this schema.

$schema.description: Optional URL or path of this JSON Schema, for editor validation. The parser accepts it and then strips it.

version.description: Config format version. Only 1 is supported.

enabled.description: Agent checks are skipped unless this is true and the runner was started with --allow-agents.

checks.description: At least one check. Names must be unique (enforced by the parser).

checkName.description: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.

run.description: Shell command run with bash from the repo root.

required.description: Script checks are required by default.

agent.description: Which already-installed agent CLI to call.

prompt.description: Instructions for the agent. The diff is appended after it on stdin.

command.description: Override the command. Required when agent is custom. Defaults: claude-code -> `claude -p`, codex -> `codex exec -`.

required.description: Agent checks default to optional so a flaky model does not block merges by accident.

aiDetection.description: Detect AI-generated changes and apply extra policy to them. Off by default.

enabled.description: Off by default: nothing is detected and no policy applies.

commit_trailers.description: Look for Co-authored-by trailers of known AI tools and generator markers in commit messages.

branch_prefixes.description: Head branch prefixes that mark a PR as AI-generated.

labels.description: PR labels that mark a PR as AI-generated (case-insensitive).

markers.description: Extra case-insensitive phrases to look for in the PR body/title and commit messages.

require_checks.description: These checks become required (and must actually run) when the change is AI-generated. Each name must match a check (enforced by the parser).

require_approval.description: AI-generated changes fail the gate until someone approves them.
